details.summary: This is an exceptionally well-crafted recipe that perfectly fits the book's dietary philosophy, time constraints, and instructional standards. It delivers a satisfying, high-fiber, balanced meal without relying on extensive cooking times or inaccessible ingredients.

dimensions.feedback: The flavor profile is excellent and well-balanced. The beef is properly seasoned and moistened with a quick pan-sauce of broth, making it highly compatible with the fresh lettuce, pico de gallo, and creamy avocado.
Flawless consistency. Every ingredient listed is properly utilized in the correct sequence during the instructions.

The instructions are exemplary for a beginner. They include clear time ranges (5 to 7 minutes), precise check times (Check at 5 minutes), and excellent visual cues ('well browned', 'liquid reduces and glazes').
The ingredients and techniques fit cleanly into a modern, health-conscious Mexican-American profile.
Skillet browning followed by a brief deglaze is the perfect method for keeping ultra-lean 96% beef from drying out. Using the microwave for pouch rice fits the convenience goal nicely.
The computed nutrition panel accurately reflects the ingredients. The high protein comes from the lean beef and beans, and the fiber correctly maps to the beans, avocado, and brown rice.

The title matches the dish perfectly, and the intro strikes the right tone—focusing practically on how the dish delivers liver-supporting fiber without using any banned 'detox' or 'cleanse' terminology.
Highly appealing. It's a colorful, vibrant, and satisfying lunch bowl that looks like real food rather than 'diet food'.

An excellent example of hitting both condition goals simultaneously: replacing saturated fat with lean protein and avocado, while delivering a robust, fiber-rich whole grain and legume base for blood sugar control.

Zero added sugars, and the carbohydrate profile is exactly what this book demands: a substantial 48.8g of high-quality, high-fiber complex carbohydrates from intact brown rice and pinto beans, well within the target window.
Perfectly suited for the 'Lunches' chapter. It is quick to assemble, hits all macro targets (sat fat under 5g, sodium under 550mg), and works wonderfully as a desk-friendly meal.

A true under-30-minute recipe. Leveraging ready-to-eat pouch brown rice, canned beans, and store-bought fresh pico de gallo are superb time-saving strategies that keep the active time well under 20 minutes.
